entry.title: Dr. Park presented his research work at the 2026 KSMI conference

link.title: Dr. Park presented his research work at the 2026 KSMI conference

entry.content:
Dr. Park shared his research progress at the 2026 Korea institute for Structural Maintenance and Inspection (KSMI) conference.

  • Sangwook Park, “Seismic Performance and Replacement Strategies for Steel Special Moment Frames with Fuse Connections under Successive Earthquakes”
  • Sangwook Park, “SAM-Based Structural Monitoring Framework Using a Single Point Cloud”
entry.summary: Dr. Park shared his research progress at the 2026 Korea institute for Structural Maintenance and Inspection (KSMI) conference.
